title: nf-core/pipeline YAML samplesheet
description: Per-sample inputs and kmer-ord project/cluster/visualise settings.

items.description: A dimensionality-reduction method. 'all' runs every method.

items.errorMessage: Screen specs must look like 'method=v1,v2,...' or 'all=v1,v2,...' (no spaces)

id.errorMessage: Sample id must be provided and cannot contain spaces

reads.errorMessage: Reads file must be provided, cannot contain spaces, and must end in .fa, .fasta, .fna, .fq, .fastq, or gzipped variants

inject_tsv.errorMessage: Optional inject file must be a .tsv/.txt path without spaces whose first column is 'sequence_id'

kmers.description: K-mer sizes to run independently for this sample.

verbose.description: Pass --verbose to kmer-ord project. Shows full rDNA-miner, Tiara, and dimensionality-reduction logs. The default is a short summary.

rdna_platform.description: Sequencing platform for rDNA-miner in kmer-ord project (only used when rdna is true).

rdna_db_dir.description: rDNA-miner database directory for this sample. Replaces --rdna_db_dir. The directory may not exist yet; kmer-ord rdna-db installs rfam/, pr2/, and silva/ when any of them is missing.
rdna_db_dir.errorMessage: rdna_db_dir must be a directory path without spaces

rdna_rfam_db.description: Override path to the Rfam database directory. Passed as --rdna-rfam-db only when rdna is true.
rdna_rfam_db.errorMessage: rdna_rfam_db must be an existing directory path without spaces

rdna_pr2_db.description: Override path to the PR2 database directory. Passed as --rdna-pr2-db only when rdna is true.
rdna_pr2_db.errorMessage: rdna_pr2_db must be an existing directory path without spaces

rdna_silva_db.description: Override path to the SILVA database directory. Passed as --rdna-silva-db only when rdna is true.
rdna_silva_db.errorMessage: rdna_silva_db must be an existing directory path without spaces

dr_project.description: Dimensionality-reduction methods to run in kmer-ord project workflow.

dr_cluster.description: Dimensionality-reduction methods to run in kmer-ord cluster workflow.

scale.description: Dataset scale preset for DR hyperparameters.

dims.description: Low-dimensional (2D/3D) projection size used by kmer-ord project.

cluster_dims.description: High-dimensional embedding size used by kmer-ord cluster.

cluster.description: Clustering methods to run in kmer-ord cluster.

pca_pre_method.description: PCA algorithm for pca_pre: 'pca' (exact, more RAM) or 'ipca' (incremental/batched, low RAM).

pca_pre_batch_size.description: IncrementalPCA batch size (only used with pca_pre_method 'ipca').

screen_values1.description: Explicit axis-1 (count-like) screen values per DR method, e.g. 'umap=5,10,15' or 'all=10,20'.

screen_values2.description: Explicit axis-2 screen values per DR method, e.g. 'umap=0.1,0.5'.

screen_range1.description: Axis-1 range for auto-generated screen grids, e.g. 'umap=5,50' or 'all=5,50'.

screen_range2.description: Axis-2 range for auto-generated screen grids, e.g. 'umap=0.1,0.9'.

screen_grid.description: Grid size for auto-generated screens: 'N' (1D) or 'NxM' (2D). Applies to every screened DR method.

dr_on_failure.description: What to do when a DR method fails in kmer-ord project or cluster. 'continue' skips that method and runs the rest. 'abort' stops immediately. Passed as --dr-on-failure only when set to abort.

max_categories.description: Max number of categories for categorical feature plots in kmer-ord visualise.

embeddings.description: Generate embedding plots in kmer-ord visualise.

embedding_mode.description: Embedding plot mode for kmer-ord visualise.

features.description: Generate feature plots in kmer-ord visualise.
